tasks.short: Communicate licensing and compliance matters with authorities

steps.what: Establish the authority's question, licensing context and verified technical evidence for the response
Draft correspondence explaining the evidence and proposed answers to compliance questions

loop.input: response brief and identified controlled records
loop.output: draft with each technical claim linked to its source
loop.check: Engineer checks technical meaning, completeness against the actual question and absence of unsupported compliance commitments
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unresolved or sensitive passages are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot explain varied technical evidence in response to free-text questions

steps.what: Verify and communicate the response, discuss responsibilities and record the authority's clarifications

tasks.design: Draft correspondence from a checked response brief and versioned evidence in {DOCS}. The engineer verifies every claim and communicates through {EMAIL} or a meeting, retaining the discussion and any resulting clarification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explaining technical records in clear correspondence required a fresh prose draft for each question.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can propose wording without deciding licensing obligations or making commitments.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently accurate sentence may misstate the scope of evidence or imply an unsupported compliance position.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer understands technical limits and negotiates a shared interpretation of the question.
tasks.altitude: First-draft effort may fall slightly; authority relationships and compliance decisions stay with people.

reach.task: Frame technical evidence for an authority enquiry
reach.learn: Scope control and clear separation of evidence from commitments

evidence.claim: A source-grounded correspondence drafting loop is a model-knowledge design; the digest provides no measured case for biomedical authority communication.

assumptions: Boundary is engineer preparation and communication, not obtaining a licence or the authority's own assessment. Existing controlled records are prepared in their respective engineering workflows.

In fully retained s1 the engineer captures the actual question, recipient, product and version, relevant evidence versions, known limitations and proposed response scope. No pre-existing compliant flag is assumed.

The loop reads that brief and records directly. Missing or contradictory evidence is handled manually in s1 or s2; authority clarifications arise during s3 and are captured there, not presumed available beforehand.
Test approved native drafting functions before custom code. Additional regulatory sign-off, if required locally, must be assigned and timed before claiming savings.
All live discussion, final checking and clarification capture remain at full time; new drafting and source maintenance have an explicit allowance.
unknowns: Who is authorised to communicate with each authority
research_questions: Does a source-linked draft reduce preparation without creating extra scope or evidence corrections?

already_counted.description: Check and correct the correspondence draft against source meaning

incremental.description: Maintain drafting instructions and source access
Regulatory affairs resolves changed communication requirements

approvals.approved_version: Exact final correspondence text, evidence versions, recipient and commitments checked in s3; changed wording or new commitments require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=94; gross 6 minus 3 focal upkeep gives central net 3. Range covers enquiries needing full manual drafting versus a small reusable explanation; authority discussion and technical checking keep all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop methods for transferring biological processes to commercial production

steps.what: Develop methodologies for transferring laboratory procedures to commercial manufacturing through engineering analysis and trials

tasks.design: Retain experimental reasoning and scale-up methodology development with the engineer, using controlled evidence in {DOCS} and the {OTHER} process engineering environment. Existing calculations support trials, while the engineer tests whether laboratory behaviour transfers to manufacturing conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Biological response and process behaviour can change with scale, equipment and operating conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Engineering tools support analysis, but no supplied evidence establishes a repeatable substitute for this methodology development.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently successful laboratory process can fail at commercial scale for reasons not captured in the available data.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer designs informative trials and revises the causal explanation when observations contradict it.
tasks.altitude: Scientific and transfer-design responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess whether laboratory procedures are operable on production equipment

evidence.claim: Retaining experimental scale-up methodology development is a model-knowledge boundary; simulation and document products do not establish a saving for this exact task.

assumptions: Boundary is development of the transfer methodology, not routine production or separately assigned document release. Trial design, interpretation and methodology writing remain counted together in s1.

Laboratory staff produce existing procedure and result records; manufacturing staff provide equipment constraints. New trial observations are produced during s1 experiments and interpreted there, not assumed ready at the task's start.
No structured transfer-ready or safety flag is presumed. The engineer resolves missing information through further observation and trials within fully retained work.
Test existing process engineering functions before considering custom tools. OTHER denotes process engineering and experimental analysis software.
No new automation or data contract is introduced; incremental upkeep is zero and existing solver runtime earns no labour saving.
research_questions: Which scale-dependent uncertainties require new physical evidence rather than document processing?

already_counted.description: Engineering analysis, trial interpretation and methodology development

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental=0. Scale-up reasoning and trials remain unchanged; no artificial clerical baseline is introduced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on controlled technical documents and validation reports

steps.what: Collaborate with manufacturing and quality staff to establish specifications, procedures and verified evidence
Prepare specification sheets, procedures, manuals or validation report drafts from the checked evidence

loop.purpose: Draft explanatory text within a controlled document template
loop.input: technical document brief, controlled requirements and cited test evidence
loop.output: document draft with traceable statements and unresolved gaps marked
loop.check: Engineer compares instructions, limits and conclusions with actual requirements and evidence; unsupported safety claims are rejected
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved evidence or instruction conflicts return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates can insert known values but cannot explain varied procedures and test findings

steps.what: Verify technical meaning with collaborators and accept the exact document for controlled quality review

tasks.design: Use controlled requirements and evidence in {DOCS} and an {OTHER} engineering requirements and validation system to populate approved templates. A bounded loop drafts explanatory passages; the engineer and collaborators check meaning before the engineer accepts the exact version for the separate quality release process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Technical document writing mixed repeated formatting with explanations drawn from varied evidence and discussions.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled records can supply traceable values while bounded drafting proposes prose for engineering review.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent instruction can reverse a limit, omit a condition or imply evidence that was never collected.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer reconciles manufacturing reality, requirements and evidence into an instruction people can safely follow.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft effort leaves technical collaboration and acceptance fully with the engineer.

reach.task: Review document traceability and release readiness

evidence.claim: Relatics supports requirements and verification management, and Kneat Gx supports validation protocols and records; these capabilities support controlled source handling, not automatic technical acceptance.
The bounded prose drafting loop and its labour assumptions are model-knowledge proposals, without a measured biomedical document-writing result.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's collaboration, drafting and technical acceptance; independent quality release, test execution and production operation are separate and earn no saving here.

In fully retained s1 the engineer captures document type, audience, product version, applicable requirements, limits, procedure sequence, source ids and unresolved questions. Manufacturing and quality colleagues supply their existing evidence; added clarification is counted as other-role work.
Known values are copied from checked sources; no unproduced compliant or validated flag is assumed. The loop reads the brief directly and gaps return to manual enquiries and writing in s1 or s2.
Test native templates, controlled record links and permitted drafting functions before custom code. OTHER denotes engineering requirements and validation management.
Technical acceptance in s3 is not final product or quality release. Upkeep and collaborator corrections are additional to the retained drafting review and collaboration time.
unknowns: Document control and independent release requirements
Permission to process technical evidence in drafting tools
Actual proportion of repeated explanatory text
research_questions: Can a reviewed draft preserve every operational condition and limit without increasing technical correction time?

already_counted.description: Check and correct the generated technical prose

incremental.description: Maintain templates, source mapping and drafting checks
Quality and manufacturing staff resolve additional drafting ambiguities

approvals.approved_version: Exact technical document version, product version, cited evidence snapshot and intended quality-review destination checked in s3; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.5; gross 10.5 minus 6 focal upkeep gives central net 4.5. Range covers novel documents needing manual prose versus limited reuse in routine drafts; collaboration, evidence capture and technical acceptance retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research new materials for biomedical products

steps.what: Research new materials through critical reading, experimental investigation and interpretation of product suitability

tasks.design: Retain materials research and critical interpretation with the engineer using {DOCS} and the {OTHER} materials research and laboratory analysis environment. Existing search and calculation functions support the investigation without replacing experimental evidence or conclusions about product suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Published properties do not by themselves establish how a material behaves in the intended biomedical application.
tasks.enabler_now: Tools can organise evidence, but this digest provides no demonstrated replacement for the research reasoning and experiments in this task.
tasks.still_hard: Biological response, durability and manufacturing interactions may remain uncertain until representative tests are performed.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies what evidence would falsify a promising material hypothesis.
tasks.altitude: Research responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Design tests of a candidate material's behaviour in its intended environment
reach.learn: Limits of property extrapolation and experimental validity

evidence.claim: Retaining critical materials research and experimental interpretation is a model-knowledge boundary; general simulation capabilities do not prove material suitability or task savings.

assumptions: Boundary is research findings, not clinical approval, product release or routine manufacturing. Literature assessment and experiments are retained rather than relabelled as paperwork.

Authors produce published studies; laboratory personnel and the engineer produce test observations during the investigation. Source conditions, test methods and uncertainty are interpreted in fully counted s1, not assumed as a ready suitability code.
Missing or incomparable evidence leads to manual reading or further experiments, with no automatic inference of safety or biocompatibility.
Test existing research and analysis functions before any custom code. OTHER denotes materials research and laboratory analysis software.
There is no new automation, integration or additional data capture, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Material type and intended biomedical environment
research_questions: Which candidate material properties cannot be extrapolated to the intended product environment?

already_counted.description: Critical reading, experiments and interpretation of materials evidence

incremental.description: No additional process or automation upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0 and incremental=0. Critical reading and materials experiments remain fully counted; no laboratory or research saving is inferred from general writing tools.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Evidence-linked drafts may reduce some writing effort; scientific reasoning, technical acceptance and external commitments remain with the engineer.
reach: Work with regulatory affairs on precise evidence scope
Work with quality staff on controlled technical document acceptance
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who can explain the limits of evidence as clearly as the proposed design or process.
